items.description: Cleaning of affected floor areas in the utility room
items.rationale: Covered as necessary cleaning of surfaces affected by the insured water damage (7.1.7(h), 7.1.5). Utility room floor was directly affected.

items.description: Cleaning of affected floor areas in the adjoining hallway
items.rationale: Covered as necessary cleaning of surfaces affected by the insured water damage (7.1.7(h), 7.1.5). Hallway floor was directly affected.

items.description: Inspection of the washing machine and supply/drain connection to confirm no further leakage
items.rationale: Covered as necessary investigation to confirm the source and cessation of the leak (7.1.7(e)).

items.description: Removal and disposal of water-damaged skirting boards
items.rationale: Covered as removal/disposal of damaged building components directly affected by the water (7.1.7(a), 7.1.5).
Covered as reinstatement of damaged building components to pre-loss standard (7.1.1(b), 7.1.9). Only for affected areas.

items.description: Cleaning and repainting of the upstairs bedroom not reached by the water
items.rationale: Not covered: work in a room not itself affected by the insured event is excluded (7.1.5).

items.description: Moisture measurement of the utility room and hallway floor
items.rationale: Covered as necessary investigation to establish the extent of damage (7.1.7(e)). Both rooms were affected.

items.description: Drying of the affected floor area
items.rationale: Covered as necessary drying of affected areas (7.1.7(b)), limited to the utility room and hallway.
Covered as necessary equipment hire for drying affected areas (7.1.7(b)), provided it relates to the utility room/hallway.
Covered as necessary labour for the drying and measurement work in affected areas (7.1.7(g)).

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of the basement storage room
items.rationale: Not covered: basement storage room was not affected by the documented water damage (7.1.5).

items.description: Transport of the high-value painting to the specialist restorer
items.rationale: Covered as part of securing/conserving an item of particular value affected by the insured event (5.2.6).

items.description: Professional assessment of the high-value painting
items.rationale: Covered as part of securing/conserving an item of particular value affected by the insured event (5.2.6).

items.description: Conservatory drying and stabilisation of the painting
items.rationale: Covered as part of securing/conserving an item of particular value affected by the insured event (5.2.6).
Covered as restoration of an item of particular value affected by the insured event, but capped at EUR 1,000 plus VAT as not scheduled (5.2.6).

items.description: Restoration of a second painting stored in the basement, unaffected by the utility-room leak
items.rationale: Not covered: painting was not affected by the insured event (7.1.5, 5.2.6).
Not covered: general administrative/processing fees are excluded (7.1.8(b)).
